text: The 2018 ICO boom exposed a core limitation of blockchain technology: ICOs sold investors decentralized infrastructure products on the assumption that a baseline infrastructure already existed, and that assumption proved false.
citation: Kaal, Financial Technology and Hedge Funds (2019). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3409548
abstract: The limitations of blockchain technology became most apparent in the aftermath of the ICO boom of 2018. ICOs promised investors core decentralized infrastructure products that assumed a baseline infrastructure existed. This turned out to be false

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: projects presupposing mature base layer infrastructure
